children.name: phSubtitle
children.text: Pre-packaged game-server templates pulled from your configured module sources.

children.name: Background refresh error with retained draft
text
children.text: Registries, git repositories, archives, and uploads the operator pulls module bundles from. Equivalent to applying ModuleSource resources directly.

children.name: text
children.text: Vanilla / Paper / Spigot / Bukkit / Purpur / Forge / NeoForge / Fabric / Quilt servers with a version+loader picker and in-app Modrinth browse.

children.name: mc2
texts: Cross-platform edition for mobile, console and Windows clients. Allow-list and permissions managed from the wizard.

children.name: mc3
texts: Valheim dedicated server (lloesche/valheim-server) with a stable/public-test channel picker, a BepInEx mod volume, and in-app Thunderstore browse. Crossplay-friendly.

children.name: mc4
texts: Factorio headless server (factoriotools/factorio) with a stable/latest/pinned channel picker, server-settings managed from the wizard, and a mods volume with in-app Factorio mod portal browse.

children.name: mc5
texts: Palworld dedicated server (thijsvanloef/palworld-server-docker) with RCON console, save-aware graceful stop, and a .pak mod volume with archive install.

children.name: mc6
texts: Dinosaur survival on the Unreal engine. Mod install via the Steam workshop; schedule onto a GPU node for acceptable tick rates.

children.name: mc7
texts: Terraria + tModLoader dedicated server (passivelemon/terraria-docker) with a vanilla/tModLoader version picker and a tModLoader ModPacks volume. Console via container stdin.

children.name: text
children.text: Competitive shooter with MatchZy and CounterStrikeSharp plugin support. Game-server login token supplied as a secret.

children.name: text
children.text: Hardcore multiplayer survival with Oxide and Carbon mod loaders. Monthly forced wipe; schedule a backup before each one.

children.name: mc10
texts: Zombie survival crafting in a destructible voxel world. Blood-moon horde nights are CPU-spiky — give it headroom.

children.name: mc11
texts: Satisfactory dedicated server (wolveix/satisfactory-server) with a stable/experimental branch picker. Env-configured; installs via steamcmd on first boot.
